title: dbce.selftest@1 result
description: result.json, written last by the mod in <selftest folder>\<name>\ (or invalid\ when the script's name cannot be read): its existence means the run is over. docs/SELFTEST.md.

name.description: The script's name; empty when it could not be read.

pass.description: Every step ran and none failed.

ms.description: From reading the script to writing this file.

failure.description: The first failure; null when the run passed.

step.description: The step number, from 1; 0 for the script itself or the force feedback mute.

log.description: The mod's log tail, when the mod gave one.

steps.description: One item per step after repeats; empty when the script could not be read.

do.description: The step in words, such as "camera next (2/5)".

status.description: skipped: after a failure (a last quit still runs).

file.description: What a capture or dump wrote, beside this file.
